g.text: Does local uncertainty analysis continue across the interface?

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4c5865

g.text: Separate from topic frequency: one assessed continuity category per article and context.
E confirms quantified outputs for selected inputs, not complete S1–S5 continuity. P retains documented limitations.
Other → S5 includes two complementary damage studies and a methodological review. S3 → S4 has no assessed article here.
20 papers generate 23 context assessments. U10 is abstract-only and excluded. No claim about the entire indexed literature.
P Partial or incompletely documented transfer
E Quantified outputs for selected uncertain inputs
